expected_output_schema.rational_encoding: All Integer and Rational leaves serialized as exact strings, including row counts and discrete particle counts. Rational nonintegers use numerator/denominator. No approximate conversion.
expected_output_schema.Null_encoding: JSON null, preserved by explicit encoder rule; unknown budget is not zero.
expected_output_schema.event_rows: 36 constructed non-cold conditional event applications, each with source values and direct four-vector independent oracle; no physical rate interpretation.
expected_output_schema.ensemble_rows: 6 constructed conditional same-channel correlated-owner aggregate applications with independently weighted oracle.
expected_output_schema.verification: Raw assertion labels/booleans, count, guard Failure tags, symbolic exact expressions and failures remain separate from application row counts.
expected_output_schema.partial_failure: FAIL_FIRST_ATTEMPT_PRESERVED or TIME_LIMIT_EXCEEDED/ABORTED with partial row and assertion lists; no subsequent automatic execution.
expected_output_schema.external_receipt: Root preserves full raw connector response and independently decoded JSON report, exact request code/hash, observed start/end, result and failure status. No source file overwrite.

serialization_metadata_check.scope: Source-level metadata inspection only; no Wolfram evaluation or serializer runtime test performed.

model_identity.request_evidence: Root reports actual spawn request under central tiered policy; backend identity remains unobserved.
